comment: the-internet's login: Jev types a username and a password from data (the page publishes both), submits, then logs out. The password is listed in secrets although it is public, to exercise masking on a value Jev types itself. text_in on #flash because the login page's own copy talks about the secure area.
goal: Log in with the given username and password so that the secure area says 'You logged into a secure area!', then click Logout, so that the login page shows the message 'You logged out of the secure area!'.
notes: The Username and Password fields are on the Login Page; the Login button submits them. The secure area has a Logout button.

checks.logged_in: The heading says 'Secure Area' and a Logout button is shown
checks.login_error: A message bar says the username or the password is invalid

logged_out.when: The message bar says 'You logged out of the secure area!'. The 'Login Page' heading is shown

login_rejected.when: The message bar says 'Your username is invalid!' or 'Your password is invalid!'
login_rejected.note: the credentials are the ones the page itself publishes

text_in.contains: You logged out of the secure area!
